description:
Priority: P0 (build/style). File: Cargo.toml -> [package.metadata.bacon.jobs.clippy]. Reference: keystore.

Problem: Job is `command = ["cargo", "clippy", "--all-targets", "--workspace"]` with no `-D warnings`, so a clean monitor/bacon run does NOT predict a clean CI.

Change: Point the job at the clippy-strict alias from TPL-003:
  [package.metadata.bacon.jobs.clippy]
  command = ["cargo", "clippy-strict"]
  need_stdout = false

Acceptance: Bacon's clippy job fails on warnings, matching the CI clippy command exactly; config still lives under [package.metadata.bacon] (no bacon.toml).
Depends on: TPL-003.
title: [TPL-004] Make the bacon clippy job blocking and CI-identical
